---- MODULE M ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets, TLC
CONSTANTS P, Q
VARIABLES seen, y, x
Init == x \in P /\ y \in Q /\ seen = {}
Change == \E p \in P : x' = p /\ UNCHANGED <<y,seen>>
Grow == \E p \in P : seen' = seen \cup {p} /\ UNCHANGED <<x,y>>
Other == \E q \in Q : y' = q /\ UNCHANGED <<x,seen>>
Next == Change \/ Grow \/ Other
Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_<<x,y,seen>>
Sym == Permutations(P) \cup Permutations(Q)
View == x
Inv == Cardinality(seen) <= 0
Prop == <> (Cardinality(seen) = 1)
====
config: CONSTANTS P = {p1, p2} Q = {q2,q1,q3} SPECIFICATION Spec SYMMETRY Sym INVARIANT Inv PROPERTY Prop CHECK_DEADLOCK FALSE

---- MODULE M ----
EXTENDS Naturals, TLC
CONSTANTS P, a, b
VARIABLES x, bit
vars == <<x,bit>>
Init == x \in P /\ bit = 0
Change == \E p \in P : x' = p /\ bit' = 1 - bit
Toggle == x' = x /\ bit' = 1 - bit
Next == Change \/ Toggle
Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars
Sym == Permutations(P)
View == x
Prop == []<><<Toggle>>_vars
====
